```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load raw CSV and clean it inside R
songs <- read_csv("songs_normalize.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  distinct() |>                                      # Remove 59 exact duplicates (2000 -> 1941)
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2019) |>              # Keep strictly 2000–2019 (1899 unique tracks)
  mutate(
    duration_min = round(duration_ms / 60000, 2),    # Convert ms to minutes
    genre = na_if(genre, "set()"),                   # Fix missing-value placeholder
    genre = replace_na(genre, "Unknown"),
    primary_genre = str_trim(str_split_i(genre, ",", 1)),
    is_zero_popularity = popularity == 0
  )
```
